notes.title: Demo - Patch ( 0.3.1 )
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690788/bc18b011f8a904805963a1cc30870fbc8c29c503.png
Hey Wasteland Girls and Boys!

The update from yesterday night unfortunately introduced a bug that made it impossible to progress the game after the world map unlock dialogue.

While going to the main menu and loading the game helped to avoid the problem, the patch for this bug just went live!

Hope you have fun and enjoy the demo!

By the way, thanks for the huge participation in the live stream!

Cheers
Raffa
